name: Doorstep Canvassing
description: Free, slow, and genuinely effective. Nobody ever won a news cycle knocking on doors.
flavour: Four hours of doorsteps. Two dogs, one shouting match, and a man who wanted to discuss the bins for forty minutes.

name: Staged Photo Op
description: High impact with the credulous. Everyone else can smell the staging.
flavour: The candidate holds a locally-sourced vegetable at an unnatural angle for nine minutes.

name: Media Buy
description: Expensive, broad, shallow. Buys a little goodwill absolutely everywhere.
flavour: Thirty seconds of drone footage over the seafront and a voiceover that says the word 'future' four times.

name: Attack Ad
description: Enormous with the group you aim it at. Everyone else finds it a bit much.
flavour: A grainy black-and-white photograph of the opponent, slowly zooming, set to a cello.

name: Debate Prep
description: Moves no polls today. Steadies the candidate and gets your own voters to actually turn up.
flavour: Six hours in a function room teaching a grown adult not to say the first thing they think.
